usedFor: Paystack holds payments and subscriptions, and Freshsales Classic updates the related deal through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Cancelled Subscription” in Paystack, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is a deal change worth recording, so its stage or amount can be corrected.

watchOut: “Cancelled Subscription” is polling, so deals update after a scheduled check, and “Update Deal” needs a deal ID or name.
